purpose: Verify an 8192-square decoded image and one 128 MiB streamed generated resource across normalization, immutable storage, durable metadata, and cold restart.

evidence.image.width: Acceptance workload for the verified target-engine feature-level floor; not a framework default.
evidence.image.height: Acceptance workload for the verified target-engine feature-level floor; not a framework default.
evidence.image.channels: RGBA decode cardinality required by this exact workload.
evidence.media.resourceBytes: Acceptance workload aligned to the verified target-engine resource floor; not a framework default.
evidence.media.chunkBytes: Explicit acceptance-host stream quantum that divides the resource exactly; not a framework default.
evidence.progressTimeoutMs: Explicit acceptance-run progress budget; observations are reported and this is not an SLA.
evidence.maxMaterializedBytes: Exact larger value of the 256 MiB decoded-image buffer and 128 MiB generated-resource buffer required by this workload.
evidence.attachmentLimits.maxInputBytes: Explicit acceptance-host byte budget equal to the 128 MiB workload envelope.
evidence.attachmentLimits.maxInputPixels: Exact product of the configured image width and height.
evidence.attachmentLimits.maxInputDimension: Exact configured image edge; resizing would invalidate this workload.
evidence.attachmentLimits.maxStoredBytes: Explicit acceptance-host byte budget equal to the 128 MiB workload envelope.
evidence.attachmentLimits.maxStoredPixels: Exact product of the configured image width and height.
evidence.attachmentLimits.maxStoredDimension: Exact configured image edge; resizing would invalidate this workload.
evidence.attachmentLimits.maxReadBytes: Explicit acceptance-host byte budget equal to the stored-byte envelope.
evidence.attachmentLimits.maxNameBytes: Exact UTF-8 byte length of benchmark-source.png.
evidence.attachmentLimits.maxBatchInputBytes: Single-image batch budget equal to maxInputBytes.
evidence.attachmentLimits.maxBatchStoredBytes: Single-image batch budget equal to maxStoredBytes.
evidence.mediaLimits.maxIdentifierBytes: Explicit acceptance-host identifier budget covering every deterministic workload identifier.
evidence.mediaLimits.maxAdapterIdBytes: Explicit acceptance-host adapter identifier budget covering benchmark-adapter.
evidence.mediaLimits.maxRequestBytes: Explicit acceptance-host request budget for the deterministic profile request.
evidence.mediaLimits.maxJsonDepth: Explicit acceptance-host JSON depth budget above the deterministic request depth.
evidence.mediaLimits.maxProviderHandleBytes: Explicit acceptance-host budget retained for the complete MediaJobLimits contract; this synchronous workload emits no handle.
evidence.mediaLimits.maxManifestBytes: Explicit acceptance-host durable manifest budget for one output and one attempt.
evidence.mediaLimits.maxMediaTypeBytes: Explicit acceptance-host MIME-type budget covering application/octet-stream.
evidence.sqlite.busyTimeoutMs: Explicit acceptance-host SQLite lock wait budget; not a service SLA.
evidence.sqlite.maxStoredJobBytes: Explicit acceptance-host canonical media-job snapshot budget for one output and one attempt.
